description: Renovate runs self-hosted, once a night, with the operator's token: every branch it pushes is authored by the operator, which is what R1 asks of a product repository. Do not set a bot gitAuthor here.
Every merge to main deploys the site (deploy.yml), so updates arrive grouped, on Monday morning: a few deploys a week rather than one per package.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix is not held until Monday.

packageRules.description: config:recommended makes runtime dependencies `fix(deps)`. A dependency bump on a static site is a chore unless it is a security fix. `deps` is in commitlint.config.js's scope-enum, which is why the scope is not left to Renovate's defaults.
A major is a migration, not a bump. It waits on the Dependency Dashboard until somebody ticks it.
Every minor and patch of the site's npm packages in one pull request, Astro and its integrations included: `astro check && astro build` in ci.yml is the whole test, and it tests them together.
commitlint's two packages move together, majors included: the CLI and the preset are released in lockstep and a split pair is refused at install.

The workflows' actions, majors included. The Pages actions (configure-pages, upload-pages-artifact, deploy-pages) only run on a push to main, so this pull request's CI does not exercise them: after merging it, check that the deploy run that follows is green.
setup-node's node-version in ci.yml, deploy.yml and guards.yml, as one runtime. github-actions extracts it as depName `node`, so this rule comes after the actions rule to take it out of that group.
